note: Lyons argues that mathematics matters because it extends what we can understand and do, not just because it solves hard problems, and that AI could help recover and connect a body of knowledge now too vast to navigate. He sets out three priorities: sustain ambitious foundational research; develop ways to recover, organise, verify and connect mathematical knowledge; and strengthen the links between mathematics and the wider world.
title: Mathematics, artificial intelligence and the opportunities ahead
who: Terry Lyons (Oxford), Academy for the Mathematical Sciences
